overview: Euclid DR1 strong-lens searches dominate, combining CNN classification of 68 million objects with citizen science to yield 15,072 candidates. Gravitational-wave work adds LISA glitch classification, EMRI inference and third-generation BNS early warning. Other contributions include the FAIR Universe weak-lensing uncertainty benchmark, differentiable galpy backends, LLM extraction of galaxy discussions, and open XAI and observatory-monitoring tools.
